title: MFA on Ubuntu with Google Authenticator
tagline: Technical guide to enabling multi-factor authentication on Ubuntu, including for SSH.
description: I wrote a guide to enable MFA on Ubuntu with Google Authenticator and PAM, including SSH. It covers preparation, configuration and testing.
features: Preparing and updating the Ubuntu system before configuring MFA.
Generating a TOTP secret per user with Google Authenticator.
Integrating the pam_google_authenticator.so module into common-auth.
Enabling MFA for SSH connections by adjusting sshd_config.
Troubleshooting and recovery advice when a code is rejected or the clock drifts.
challenges: I needed to secure access without locking myself out of the server. I planned a backup, local tests and a rollback before enabling MFA for SSH.
learnings: I deepened my knowledge of PAM and SSH security while learning to document a clear, repeatable procedure.
